compliance.name: DPDP Compliance Portal
compliance.title: DPDP Compliance Operations
compliance.subtitle: Privacy Shield Platform — Data Protection Officer Track
compliance.description: You are the Data Protection Officer for a company that must comply with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act. Across 5 modules you connect a customer platform to the compliance portal, work the consent lifecycle, discover and classify the personal data you hold, run anonymization and third-party sharing controls, and produce the audit evidence that proves your DPDP posture.

module1.title: Module 1: Platform Integration & Consent Sync
module1.mission: Register a customer platform as a consent source on the Integration page, run the first synchronisation, and confirm the engine has analysed the sector and populated the Command Center.

module2.title: Module 2: Consent Lifecycle Management
module2.mission: Work the Consent Management workspace: inspect consent evidence, action approvals and withdrawals, read the revocation-rate and purpose-distribution intelligence, and verify every change lands in the audit trail.

module3.title: Module 3: PII Discovery & Classification
module3.mission: Run a PII scan, review the discovered fields and their sensitivity tiers, and explain how the sector pack drives the DPDP privacy-risk score shown on the PII Management dashboard.

module4.title: Module 4: Anonymization & Third-Party Sharing
module4.mission: Use the Anonymization workspace to mask a dataset before disclosure, trigger an anonymization job, and trace a third-party sharing event through the hash audit trail.

module5.title: Module 5: DPDP Compliance Audit & Reporting (Capstone)
module5.mission: Read the DPDP Compliance rule-by-rule breakdown, close the outstanding action item, generate a consolidated compliance audit report, and confirm the compliance index and next-audit date on the Command Center.
